name: [ASH] the Seeds of Destruction
source:
After Tomishogo falls to a bio-disaster, its residents become superhuman threats. Trapped within, Agent John Oswald must wield his powers, protect a young girl, and find a way out.

[From [url=https://paperdoor-studios.itch.io/ash-the-seeds-of-destruction]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
富庄乡遭遇生物灾难后，其居民成为超人威胁。约翰·奥斯瓦尔德特工被困其中，必须运用自己的力量，保护一名年轻女孩，并找到出路。

[来自[url=https://paperdoor-studios.itch.io/ash-the-seeds-of-destruction]Itch.io[/url]]
